input:
Write a bash script /home/eval/report.sh used as `bash /home/eval/report.sh INBOX_DIR OUT_FILE` (it will be run again later on other directories). INBOX_DIR holds message files `*.json` (names may contain spaces; ignore other files). Each is a JSON object whose optional "to" and "cc" fields are email address-list header strings like `"Doe, John" <john@example.com>, ann@x.org` (display names may be quoted and contain commas). Count every recipient address in to and cc by its domain (the part after '@', lowercased).
Files that are not valid JSON are skipped and reported on stderr as `skip: <file name>` (base name), in file name order. OUT_FILE gets one line `COUNT DOMAIN` per domain, sorted by count descending then domain. Exit 0.
Run it on /data/inbox writing /out/domains.txt.
